items.item_text: Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience and comfort with spreadsheets/CRM tools and data analysis.
Experience in event management and working with internal or external stakeholders.

Under the close supervision of the Senior Associate Athletics Director and Executive Director of the Aggie Varsity Club, this internship provides an opportunity to gain experience in all aspects of former UC Davis letterwinner alumni engagement. The position supports the engagement and development of UC Davis Athletics’ letterwinner community

through management of the Aggie Varsity Club Network, coordination of alumni content and communications, maintenance of accurate letterwinner data, and support of a variety of alumni and letterwinner events.
Excellent writing, editing, typing, interpersonal and verbal communication skills. Quick decision making and problem solving skills.
